summary: The statement and proof are correct and complete. Support finiteness and all real-power normalizations hold because every supported radius is positive. Coordinate halving preserves the support, satisfies the asserted radius inequality, and has at most three preimages, so the stated bound with multiplicity four is valid. The maximization and simplification give the claimed moment constants. For each nonnegative real k, the conditional likelihood ratio is nonincreasing in the remaining total energy, and exchangeability correctly converts its mean monotonicity into the pairwise covariance bound. The negative-power counterexample and its exact covariance are correct. Boundary cases, including singleton support and k = 0, cause no gap.
